players.product: Silicon carbide (SiC) substrates: conductive, semi-insulating and P-type (6/8-inch volume, 12-inch launched); also optical-grade SiC for micro-nano optics

quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and general manager Zong Yanmin (H1 2026 results briefing): the Jinan and Shanghai Lingang bases now have combined designed annual capacity of over 70 ten-thousand substrates; the Jinan advanced-materials manufacturing park is built and in production and Lingang's second-stage capacity build is proceeding. Prices have basically stabilised since the start of the year, sales are growing faster than output and capacity is already fairly tight, and he expects it to become tighter in H2 as new-energy vehicles, PV / storage / charging and AI data centers expand; the company will expand capacity through in-house crystal-growth process gains, yield and efficiency, with further expansion (including the Malaysia base serving overseas device makers) driven by orders and long-term agreements. 12-inch substrates are now delivered in batches, and several leading domestic and overseas power-device makers take 8-inch substrates in automotive-grade volume supply.
quarterly_data.figure: designed annual capacity over 70 ten-thousand substrates

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results briefing: board secretary Zhong Wenqing said AI data-center power (PSU, HVDC, SST) has become an important second growth curve after new-energy vehicles and the company is working with leading global power-device makers on next-generation data-center power solutions; semi-insulating substrate demand is growing with AI, satellite communications and radar. Chairman Zong Yanmin said SiC is already used for high-power chip heat dissipation, that work on advanced-packaging heat-spreading interposers continues with customers (names confidential), and that its single-crystal diamond growth and substrate processing project has reached the sample stage. CFO You Ying said 8-inch line utilisation keeps ramping with orders.
